definitions.explanation: A face-to-face visit, especially to see someone in a hospital, prison, or other institution. Also used for formal meetings with officials or important figures.

examples.japanese: {面会|めんかい}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
{入院中|にゅういんちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{面会|めんかい}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to visit my grandmother in the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{面会|めんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{一組|ひとくみ}→一組：26487_hitokumi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to infection control measures, visits are limited to one group per day.

notes:
USAGE:
{面会|めんかい} is most commonly used for visiting someone in an institutional setting such as a hospital or prison. It has a more formal and structured nuance than a casual visit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面会|めんかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to visit, to meet)
- {面会|めんかい}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (visiting hours)
- {面会|めんかい}{謝絶|しゃぜつ} (no visitors allowed)
- {面会|めんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go visit)
- {面会|めんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (to refuse a visit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧ focuses on visiting someone who is ill to wish them well, while {面会|めんかい} is the broader, more formal term for any institutional visit.
